These are the notes I write for myself while I learn. They are not a textbook, and I am not an expert. I write things in my own words so that I understand them, and I keep what helped.

## How I write my notes

- I note down the idea in simple words first, then add an example.
- Every chapter ends with a short summary I can revise from.
- If I get something wrong, I come back and fix it. These notes keep changing as I learn more.

## Notes will be added as i learn them
